verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's Runbooks are an automation engine, but the evidence shows them triggering on incident events ("Any time an incident is declared, Runbooks evaluate their conditions"), not on a recurring time-based schedule. The "schedules" in the pack are on-call rotations for people, an adjacent feature rather than scheduled jobs or workflows. Nothing documents cron-like or recurring workflow execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
